input-field.name: enableOrderExport
input-field.label: Send orders to Minimax
Aufträge an Minimax senden
input-field.helpText: Off by default. While off, the export still runs and logs the exact payload it would send, but nothing is created in Minimax.

allowedOrderPaymentStateToExport

input-field.name: shippingItemCode
input-field.label: Minimax item code for shipping costs
Minimax-Artikelcode für Versandkosten
input-field.helpText: Code of an item in Minimax representing shipping (e.g. "POSTNINA"). A Minimax order row carries no VAT rate of its own — it inherits it from the referenced item — so without this the shipping row is exported as free text with no VAT rate. Leave empty to keep the free-text row.

input-field.name: minimaxItemPriceIncludesVat
input-field.label: Minimax item prices already include VAT
Minimax-Artikelpreise enthalten bereits MwSt.
input-field.helpText: Leave off when the item price in Minimax is net (the Minimax default: its documents distinguish Price from PriceWithVAT). Turn on only if this organisation maintains gross item prices — otherwise the imported catalogue is off by the VAT rate.
